# Artur Yusupov - Senior Fullstack Web Engineer & AI Developer

> Official portfolio and engineering knowledge base of Artur Yusupov (Seville, Spain, European Union). Specializing in Next.js 16 (React 19 Server Components), Custom & Headless WordPress (PHP 8+, ACF Pro, REST/GraphQL), TypeScript, Autonomous Hybrid RAG AI Assistants, Shopify Liquid, and WCAG 2.2 AA / EAA 2026 web accessibility compliance.

## Core Engineering Capabilities & B2B Services

- **Fullstack Next.js 16 & React 19 Applications**: App Router, Server Components, TypeScript 6, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase, sub-second Core Web Vitals (95-100 Lighthouse, LCP < 0.8s, CLS 0.00).
- **Custom & Headless WordPress Architecture**: Bespoke PHP 8+ themes, ACF Pro flexible content blocks, WooCommerce, WPGraphQL / REST API headless decoupling, AWS cloud migrations.
- **AI Engineering & Hybrid RAG Systems**: Custom in-browser and server-side Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistants, vector embeddings, deterministic fallback engines, and Spec-Driven AI SDLC.
- **EU Accessibility & DevSecOps Compliance**: WCAG 2.2 Level AA & European Accessibility Act (EAA 2026 / EN 301 549) keyboard/screen-reader engineering, strict CSP/HSTS headers, and zero-leak client-side contact obfuscation.

## Personal Flagship Products

- [Next.js 16 & Hybrid RAG Portfolio Platform](https://www.yusupovartur.com/en/projects/yusupovartur-nextjs-portfolio): Enterprise fullstack platform with React 19 Server Components, autonomous Hybrid RAG engine indexing 71 case studies and 9 engineering articles across 246+ SSG routes (EN/UA/ES), and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance.
- [Fullstack AI Lab](https://www.yusupovartur.com/en/projects/fullstack-ai-lab): Interactive EdTech platform for Fullstack mastery (React 19, Next.js 16, WordPress core internals, TypeScript) powered by native Rust MDX-RS compilation across 1,135+ lessons, in-browser WASM WordPress 7.0 / PHP 8.4 Playground, AI Technical Interview Engine, Google NotebookLM Audio Overview prompt generator, and Supabase personal cloud progress synchronization. Live: https://www.fullstackailab.com
- [Unitrition](https://www.yusupovartur.com/en/projects/unitrition): Personalized nutrition modeling platform supporting 10 dietary regimens, built with Next.js 16 App Router, Headless WordPress, Supabase, and USDA FoodData Central API.
- [My React Portfolio Website](https://www.yusupovartur.com/en/projects/webart-react-portfolio): High-performance SPA/PWA built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, View Transitions API, and Vitest test suite.
